segments.text: Okay, they finally did it. I have a new
feature enabled on my YouTube account
that is like early access beta
basically, but I think a lot of other
creators will be very excited about this
because two years ago, we first saw
thumbnail AB testing, which is super
useful. You can see which image works
best and it's why you might log in two
different times and see two different
thumbnails for the same new YouTube
video. But the thing is, some thumbnails
are so different from each other that
you might actually use a different title
to work with them. And so that's why
we've been asking for title and
thumbnail AB testing. And now it's
actually here. And so it looks like
this. You can actually try three
different thumbnails and three different
titles. ABC testing. And so you're
testing each of them in pairs so you can
see which pair of title and thumbnail
works best. Thank you YouTube.
